subject: Inflight OKRs: tradeoffs, scope trims, and critical dependency requests
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Inflight OKRs: tradeoffs, scope trims, and critical dependency requests

Team — quick mid-run readout for the Greenline Health account ahead of the QBR. This is intentionally tight; I want commits on owners and deadlines by end of week so we can finalize the deck. High-level status:

- OKR: Secure Dedicated deployment for pilot (owner: Sales/CS) — at Risk (legal/proc timeline slowing).
- OKR: Meet target 85ms P95 for inference under realistic load — On track for model variant A but we need infra support for loadgen and KV-cache tuning.
- OKR: Zero-regression on quality after quantization — At risk until we finish the regression eval suite for the customer prompt set.

Top asks (need owners + dates):
1) Procurement/Security artifacts: provide SOC2 Type II evidence and data-retention SLA language to Greenline procurement by 09/20. (owner: Naomi)
2) Dedicated capacity readiness: SRE needs an accelerated staging window (4x throughput) and a kernel-selection sanity pass with Markus by 09/22. (owner: Markus)
3) Eval & QA: Build and run the Greenline prompt regression harness and share results by 09/23. (owner: Vanessa)
4) Deck finalization: incorporate trimmed scope and verified SLA language into QBR deck by 09/20. (owner: Laura)

Possible scope trims to propose in the QBR (to keep runway):
- Defer non-critical analytics export feature until post-pilot.
- Limit initial model variants to A/B only (no C variant rollout at pilot).

Attachments: Q3-QBR-deck-v2.pptx (draft), security-gap-list.csv (current artifacts we can share).

Please reply with: 1) who will own each ask, 2) whether the dates above are plausible, 3) any blocking risks I missed.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber | VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inflight OKRs: tradeoffs, scope trims, and critical dependency requests

Thanks — taking SOC2 / procurement lead. Quick updates / notes:

- I'll assemble the evidence pack (SOC2 summary, retention policy, encryption controls) and send to Greenline procurement by COB 09/20. I'll need a short paragraph from Legal on customer-specific retention carve-outs; looping Legal now.
- Markus: I agree we need an accelerated staging window. Can you confirm availability for a 9/22 all-hands with infra + SRE (2 hours) to run the 4x throughput pass?
- Vanessa: please confirm which prompts you need from Greenline for the regression harness. If we need more than 500 prompts we should cut the early baseline to 250 to hit the 09/23 target.

Risks: Legal may ask for contract language changes that push procurement beyond 09/20. If that happens, we should propose a conditional go-live with a limited data set and shorter retention for the pilot.

Assigning: Naomi (procurement artifacts), Markus (staging & kernel pass), Vanessa (eval harness), Laura (deck edits).

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman | Head of Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Klein <sara@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Greenline Health - Delivery <deploy@greenlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procure@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inflight OKRs: tradeoffs, scope trims, and critical dependency requests

Jonas / Naomi — thanks for the clear list. A few notes from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: our finance/legal team is aiming to finish review by 09/28, but that assumes we receive SOC2 evidence and a clear data-retention statement by 09/20. Please attach any redlines you anticipate so we can triage early.
- Security ask: we also need to confirm the encryption-at-rest key management approach. If you have an HSM/KMS diagram or whitepaper, send it with the SOC2 bundle.
- Delivery: our delivery lead (cc'd) will need a 60-minute technical kickoff after you confirm staging windows. 9/22 looks feasible; can we do 10:00am PT?

I've attached our PO template (Greenline-PO-template.docx) for your procurement team to review; our procurement contact is Mark Gill (mark.gill@greenlinehealth.com).

From our side, the pilot scope is acceptable with the following constraint: no PHI in pilot datasets. We will provide a sanitized prompt set — target 300 prompts.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Klein | Head of Product, Greenline Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.example.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.example.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara@greenlinehealth.com>, Greenline Health - Delivery <deploy@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inflight OKRs: tradeoffs, scope trims, and critical dependency requests

Team — finalizing owners and next steps after calls this week. Summary + explicit asks: 

Action list (owners & due dates):
- Naomi: SOC2 bundle + KMS/HSM diagram + short retention paragraph -> deliver to Greenline procurement by 2026-09-20 (complete).
- Markus: Staging window & 4x throughput pass on 2026-09-22 @10:00am PT. Confirmed. Please include SRE and infra. (owner: Markus)
- Vanessa: Regression harness with 300 sanitized prompts from Greenline -> run and share results by 2026-09-23. If harness needs scaling, flag immediately. (owner: Vanessa)
- Laura: Final QBR deck edits (trim analytics exports, lock pilot scope to A/B variants) -> 2026-09-20 EOD. Link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/s/greenline-qbr-deck

Notes: Legal asked for conditional language — Naomi is coordinating a short appendix that limits pilot dataset retention; we'll surface this in the deck as an explicit mitigant.

Next meeting: quick sync after the staging pass (9/22) to confirm go/no-go for the pilot rollout.

Thanks all — please reply only if your date or owner is wrong.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber | VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
